content.title: How to trade the AI boom beyond chips
content.description:
When people talk about artificial intelligence stocks, they usually think of chip companies like Nvidia (NVDA) or companies working on large language models, like Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL). But there are a number of robotics and automation companies that will benefit from the AI boom too. TMX VettaFi head of robotics and AI research Zeno Mercer shares how he is playing these stocks. He also weighs in on Meta's (META) recent smart glasses announcement.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
